+- [ ] An old `index.md` with no `importedFrom` reads as nil.
+- [ ] A failed write leaves no folder and no directory entry.
+
+## After
+
+Push when green. Send the sha to foundationmodelsacpagent-9e and testudoapp-9a. #d209
